candidates.claim: Interface GigabitEthernet1/0/14 on sw-ot-01 has spanning-tree portfast in the approved baseline, but the current configuration removes it.
candidates.remediation: Restore spanning-tree portfast on sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/14, or record the change as approved and update the baseline.

clarifications.question: rtr-01 GigabitEthernet0 (10.10.99.12/24, rtr-01:46) is a MGMT-subnet interface with no ACL binding, and rtr-01 has two default routes (rtr-01:54 via 198.51.100.1 and rtr-01:55 via 10.10.99.1). Can MGMT hosts reach OUTSIDE through rtr-01 without passing fw-01, and is rtr-01 meant to carry transit traffic between these interfaces?

rtr-01 EDGE_IN permits tcp/443 and udp/443 from any to 203.0.113.2, the fw-01 outside address (rtr-01:68, rtr-01:69). fw-01 has asa_http_server enabled (fw-01:109), while the only recorded HTTP management access is restricted to the mgmt interface from 10.10.99.0/24 (fw-01:110). Is the Internet-facing 443 permit intended, and does fw-01 serve HTTPS on the outside interface?
